plugins.purpose: TMDB metadata compatibility only; not a video-stream proxy

notes: HTTP plugin URLs may be blocked as mixed content on HTTPS hosting. Resolve through an explicitly approved HTTPS endpoint or a user-configurable compatible host; do not proxy video streams through Cloudflare.
